$comment: English texts of data/materials.json (src/engine/overlay.js): the materials of the creatures, and the parts. A material keeps its capitals in a sentence, after its rarity in lower case (src/engine/crafting.js, materialView; nameInText): "rare Wolf Pelt ×2".

wolf-pelt.name: Wolf Pelt
wolf-pelt.description: A rough grey pelt with thick fur.

badger-claws.name: Badger Claws
badger-claws.description: Short, hard claws made for digging burrows.

viper-scales.name: Viper Scale
viper-scales.description: A patch of tiny scales with a dark zigzag.

boar-tusk.name: Boar Tusk
boar-tusk.description: A curved tusk, sharp as a knife.

crow-feather.name: Raven Feather
crow-feather.description: A black feather with a dark blue sheen.

owl-feather.name: Tawny Owl Feather
owl-feather.description: A soft, speckled feather. It muffles every rustle.

wisp-flame.name: Strayling Flame
wisp-flame.description: A tiny flame that never goes out and never burns.

stag-antler.name: Stag Antlers
stag-antler.description: Wide-spreading antlers with many tines, hard as bone.

marten-fur.name: Marten Fur
marten-fur.description: Soft, dark brown fur with a cream patch on the chest.

hornet-sting.name: Hornet Sting
hornet-sting.description: A sharp sting with a drop of venom at the tip.

hailstone.name: Hailstone
hailstone.description: An icy pellet from a Cloudherder's storm. It never melts and sparks faintly.

tusker-tusks.name: Tusker Sabres
tusker-tusks.description: The long, curved tusks of an old tusker, sharp as sabres.

squirrel-tail.name: Squirrel Tail
squirrel-tail.description: A bushy russet tail, light as a feather.

grass-snake-slough.name: Grass Snake Slough
grass-snake-slough.description: A thin, translucent skin the snake shed in the grass.

raccoon-dog-fur.name: Raccoon Dog Fur
raccoon-dog-fur.description: Thick grey-brown fur with a dark stripe.

antlion-jaws.name: Antlion Jaws
antlion-jaws.description: Two curved sickles, sharp as thorns.

capercaillie-feather.name: Capercaillie Feather
capercaillie-feather.description: A long black feather with a green sheen.

weasel-fur.name: Weasel Fur
weasel-fur.description: A small, soft pelt, brown with a white belly.

stag-beetle-horn.name: Stag Beetle Horn
stag-beetle-horn.description: A glossy mandible shaped like small antlers.

snake-hawk-talon.name: Snake Eagle Talon
snake-hawk-talon.description: A hooked talon that pierces viper scales.

wildcat-fur.name: Wildcat Fur
wildcat-fur.description: Thick, striped fur, grey as bark.

black-stork-feather.name: Black Stork Feather
black-stork-feather.description: A long black feather with a coppery sheen.

lynx-fur.name: Lynx Fur
lynx-fur.description: Thick, spotted fur, warm even in winter.

spider-silk.name: Spider Silk
spider-silk.description: A ball of sticky, strong spider thread.

tarantula-hair.name: Tarantula Hair
tarantula-hair.description: A tuft of stiff, prickly hairs from a tarantula's abdomen.

spider-moults.name: Spider Moults
spider-moults.description: Paper-thin, empty husks that young spiders shed as they grew.

bird-eater-fang.name: Birdeater Fang
bird-eater-fang.description: A black, curved fang. A drop of venom still glistens on its tip.

alpha-fang.name: Alpha Fang
alpha-fang.description: The fang of a pack leader, longer than a finger.

bear-hide.name: Bear Hide
bear-hide.description: A heavy, thick hide with brown fur.

likho-eye.name: Misfortune's Eye
likho-eye.description: A cloudy, cold eye. It is still watching.

stone-heart.name: Stoneling Core
stone-heart.description: A mossy stone from inside a stoneling. It is still warm.

bat-wing.name: Bat Wing
bat-wing.description: A thin, leathery membrane stretched over delicate bones.

eagle-owl-feather.name: Eagle Owl Feather
eagle-owl-feather.description: A large, tawny feather with dark bars.

she-wolf-fur.name: She-Wolf Fur
she-wolf-fur.description: Light grey fur with white-tipped hairs.

basilisk-scale.name: Basilisk Scale
basilisk-scale.description: A shimmering scale. Whoever looks at it too long feels the chill of stone.

heron-feather.name: Heron Feather
heron-feather.description: A long grey feather with a black tip.

otter-fur.name: Otter Fur
otter-fur.description: Thick, glossy fur that keeps out the water.

mosquito-proboscis.name: Mosquito Proboscis
mosquito-proboscis.description: A long, thin proboscis, sharp as a needle.

reed-bundle.name: Reed Bundle
reed-bundle.description: A tightly woven handful of reeds, still damp.

beaver-teeth.name: Beaver Teeth
beaver-teeth.description: Two orange teeth, hard as a chisel.

mosquito-wings.name: Mosquito Wings
mosquito-wings.description: A handful of tiny clear wings, light as dust.

eel-skin.name: Eel Skin
eel-skin.description: Slippery dark skin that now and then crackles with a spark.

eagle-feather.name: Eagle Feather
eagle-feather.description: A large brown flight feather, strong as a reed.

cormorant-feather.name: Cormorant Feather
cormorant-feather.description: A black feather with a green sheen, always a little wet.

catfish-whisker.name: Catfish Whisker
catfish-whisker.description: A long, thick whisker that senses movement in murky water.

toad-venom.name: Toad Venom
toad-venom.description: A few drops of milky venom on a leaf.

crocodile-hide.name: Crocodile Hide
crocodile-hide.description: Tough, scaly hide that no ordinary knife can pierce.

willow-bark.name: Willow Bark
willow-bark.description: The cracked bark of an old willow, with rotten wood glowing in the cracks.

wraith-veil.name: Wraith Veil
wraith-veil.description: A cold grey scrap of cloth that floats in the air by itself.

mist-drop.name: Mist Drop
mist-drop.description: A cold drop that never dries and gives off a faint vapour.

drowned-tear.name: Drowned Maiden's Tear
drowned-tear.description: A clear drop, hard as glass and cold as water at dawn.

old-bone.name: Old Bone
old-bone.description: A yellowed bone, worn smooth by the water.

drowner-weeds.name: Drowner Waterweed
drowner-weeds.description: Wet green strands of waterweed, tangled like hair.

sludge-lump.name: Sludge Lump
sludge-lump.description: A sticky, greenish lump that slowly crawls across your palm.

goblin-trinket.name: Goblin Trinket
goblin-trinket.description: A brass button polished to a shine, a mud goblin's treasure.

vodnik-pearl.name: Nix Pearl
vodnik-pearl.description: A large black pearl. Something moves inside it.

crane-feather.name: Crane Feather
crane-feather.description: An ash-grey feather, long and light.

elk-antler.name: Elk Antler
elk-antler.description: A broad, flat palm of antler.

leech-slime.name: Leech Slime
leech-slime.description: Thick slime that keeps wounds from closing for a long time.

harrier-feather.name: Marsh Harrier Feather
harrier-feather.description: A rust-red feather with dark stripes.

crayfish-shell.name: Crayfish Shell
crayfish-shell.description: A hard red shell covered in spikes.

sundew-dew.name: Sundew Dew
sundew-dew.description: A sticky, sweet drop with a mosquito stuck in it.

peat-heart.name: Peatling Heart
peat-heart.description: A heavy, dark lump of peat, warm inside.

wisp-spark.name: Wisp Spark
wisp-spark.description: A tiny flame that does not go out in a closed hand.

salamander-skin.name: Salamander Skin
salamander-skin.description: Black skin with yellow spots, cool even by the fire.

peat-spade.name: Peat Cutter's Spade
peat-spade.description: A narrow spade of black oak, its handle worn smooth by hands.

worm-jaw.name: Bog Worm Jaw
worm-jaw.description: A round jaw full of small, curved teeth.

kikimora-yarn.name: Bog Hag Yarn
kikimora-yarn.description: A grey thread spun from moss and hair. It cannot be broken.

bog-heart.name: Heart of the Bog
bog-heart.description: A black lump that beats like a heart when you squeeze it.

living-moss.name: Living Moss
living-moss.description: A tuft of moss that still stirs faintly.

imp-dust.name: Imp Dust
imp-dust.description: A handful of glittering dust. It tickles your fingers.

cross-spider-silk.name: Cross Spider Thread
cross-spider-silk.description: A thick, sticky thread from a cross spider's web.

mouflon-horn.name: Mouflon Horn
mouflon-horn.description: The heavy, curled horn of a wild ram.

falcon-feather.name: Falcon Feather
falcon-feather.description: A grey feather with fine bars, hard as a blade.

werewolf-fur.name: Werewolf Hair
werewolf-fur.description: A tuft of coarse grey hair. It smells of a storm.

shepherd-crook.name: Shepherd's Crook
shepherd-crook.description: A short, knotty crook covered in frost that never melts.

aurochs-horn.name: Aurochs Horn
aurochs-horn.description: A huge horn with a black tip. Long ago such horns were made into drinking cups.

aesculapian-skin.name: Aesculapian Snakeskin
aesculapian-skin.description: A long strip of olive skin with a yellow underside.

strzyga-fang.name: Shriekwing Fang
strzyga-fang.description: A long, pale fang with a drop of blood that never dries.

phantasm-shard.name: Phantasm Shard
phantasm-shard.description: A shard of rainbow glass with mist swirling inside.

black-grouse-feather.name: Black Grouse Feather
black-grouse-feather.description: A blue-black tail feather, curved like a lyre.

diving-beetle-shell.name: Diving Beetle Shell
diving-beetle-shell.description: A glossy olive wing case with a yellow rim.

little-owl-feather.name: Great Owl Feather
little-owl-feather.description: A brown feather with white spots. It makes no rustle.

zmij-scale.name: Wyrm Scale
zmij-scale.description: A red-black scale whose edges still glow.

fume-ember.name: Smouldering Ember
fume-ember.description: A lump of coal with red cracks. It never stops smouldering.

mine-lantern.name: Hoardkeeper's Lamp
mine-lantern.description: An old brass lamp with a green flame that never goes out.

rat-tail.name: Rat Tail
rat-tail.description: A long, hairless tail curled in a loose ring.

turtle-shell.name: Turtle Shell
turtle-shell.description: A domed olive shell with yellow speckles, overgrown with moss.

mink-fur.name: Mink Fur
mink-fur.description: Glossy dark brown fur, soft and waterproof.

dragonfly-wing.name: Dragonfly Wing
dragonfly-wing.description: A clear wing with blue veins. It shimmers in the sun.

pike-teeth.name: Pike Teeth
pike-teeth.description: A row of needle-thin teeth on a piece of jaw.

silver-bubble.name: Silver Bubble
silver-bubble.description: A bubble of air in spider silk. Under water it gleams like quicksilver.

tern-feather.name: Tern Feather
tern-feather.description: A slender dark grey feather with a black tip.

bog-oak.name: Bog Oak
bog-oak.description: A piece of oak that lay in the peat for hundreds of years. Hard, and black as tar.

veles-scale.name: Veles Scale
veles-scale.description: A huge black scale with a faint golden pattern.

bone-amulet.name: Bone Amulet
bone-amulet.description: An old amulet on a leather thong, carved with a sun sign.

bog-lantern-eye.name: Mire Demon Eye
bog-lantern-eye.description: A round yellow eye that glows in the dark like a lantern.

tick-shell.name: Giant Tick Shell
tick-shell.description: A hard, rust-brown shell. Empty inside.

night-heron-plume.name: Night Heron Plume
night-heron-plume.description: Long, thin white feathers from a night heron's head.

bies-horn.name: Fiend Horn
bies-horn.description: A short, thick black horn with a cracked tip. Warm to the touch.

black-fleece.name: Black Fleece
black-fleece.description: A tuft of matted black hair that smells of sulphur.

klobuk-feather.name: Fiery Feather
klobuk-feather.description: A wet black feather whose tip still smoulders.

mamuna-braid.name: Cradle Thief's Braid
mamuna-braid.description: A long braid of black hair tied with a red thread. Always wet.

cyrograf.name: Devil's Pact
cyrograf.description: A scroll of yellowed parchment with a signature in blood and a red seal.

glassy-sand.name: Glassy Sand
glassy-sand.description: A handful of sand that glitters like broken glass. It sifts between your fingers, though nothing stirs it.

everheather.name: Undying Heather
everheather.description: A sprig of heather that never withers. It smells of honey and sleep.

nightjar-feather.name: Nightjar Feather
nightjar-feather.description: A soft feather with grey-brown stripes, like pine bark. It makes no sound in flight.

amber-lump.name: Amber Lump
amber-lump.description: A golden lump of resin with an insect trapped inside. Warm in the hand, as if alive.

bored-bark.name: Tunnelled Bark
bored-bark.description: A slab of pine bark full of winding tunnels. Something still scrabbles inside them.

moth-dust.name: Moth Dust
moth-dust.description: A pinch of black dust from a tar moth's wings. It sticks to your fingers and stings your eyes.

husk-dust.name: Husk Dust
husk-dust.description: A handful of grey dust, dry as old bones. It dries out everything it touches.

whirl-pebble.name: Whirl Pebble
whirl-pebble.description: A smooth, round pebble polished by the wind. Laid on your palm, it slowly turns by itself.

bronze-ring.name: Bronze Ring
bronze-ring.description: An old ring from a barrow, covered in green patina. Cold as ice, even in the heat.

birch-tar.name: Birch Tar
birch-tar.description: Thick black pitch from birch bark that smells of smoke. Tar burners rubbed it on wheels and wounds.

glowing-ember.name: Live Coal
glowing-ember.description: A small coal glowing bright orange. Now and then it hops by itself, as if trying to escape.

latawiec-membrane.name: Gale Sprite Membrane
latawiec-membrane.description: A thin grey membrane from the wing of a Gale Sprite. It rustles even when there is no wind.

charred-splinter.name: Charred Splinter
charred-splinter.description: A black splinter of pine that still glows inside. It does not go out even in the rain.

ruin-ash.name: Cinder Ash
ruin-ash.description: A handful of grey ash from the burnt forest. It never cools and cannot be blown away.

everspark.name: Undying Spark
everspark.description: A tiny bright spark that will not go out. It hovers over your palm and warms like a campfire.

noon-sickle.name: Noon Witch's Sickle
noon-sickle.description: An old iron sickle with a worn wooden handle. At high noon the blade glows red-hot.

rarog-feather.name: Firehawk Feather
rarog-feather.description: A long feather from the Firehawk's fiery tail. It burns, but never burns away.

black-needle.name: Black Needle
black-needle.description: A long black spruce needle that never breaks or dulls.

copper-scale.name: Copper Scale
copper-scale.description: A warm scale with a coppery sheen. It trembles when someone comes near.

glass-tooth.name: Glass Tooth
glass-tooth.description: A clear tooth you can see only against the light.

millipede-segment.name: Millipede Segment
millipede-segment.description: A black, glossy ring of armour with a pair of little legs that still move.

fern-curl.name: Fern Curl
fern-curl.description: A young, curled fern frond, black as soot.

mantis-blade.name: Mantis Blade
mantis-blade.description: A pale, spiny mantis foreleg, sharp as a razor.

dog-skull.name: Dog Skull
dog-skull.description: A long skull with sharp fangs, too big for a dog.

coachman-whip.name: Coachman's Whip
coachman-whip.description: A long leather whip that cracks by itself when night falls.

rainbow-eye.name: Rainbow Eye
rainbow-eye.description: A huge insect eye made of thousands of tiny eyes, shimmering like oil on water.

tangled-root.name: Tangled Root
tangled-root.description: A thick root twisted into a knot, still shedding soil.

congealed-murk.name: Congealed Murk
congealed-murk.description: A lump of cold black ooze that reflects no light.

black-rope.name: Black Rope
black-rope.description: A thick rope braided from roots, cold and damp.

gnawed-bone.name: Gnawed Bone
gnawed-bone.description: A huge bone with deep tooth marks, hard as iron.

rotten-pelt.name: Rotten Hide
rotten-pelt.description: A patch of fur and hide that has been rotting for a hundred years and still holds together.

broken-leash.name: Broken Leash
broken-leash.description: A thick black leather leash, snapped right at the collar.

whistling-feather.name: Whistling Feather
whistling-feather.description: A grey feather that whistles at the slightest movement, so shrilly that leaves wither.

hunting-horn.name: Hunting Horn
hunting-horn.description: A black horn bound with silver. When someone blows it, the whole forest falls silent.

grey-beard.name: Grey Beard
grey-beard.description: A long tuft of grey lichen, cold as hoarfrost.

bony-finger.name: Bony Finger
bony-finger.description: A long finger with a black claw that still bends.

murmuring-cone.name: Whispering Cone
murmuring-cone.description: A pine cone that whispers like a whole forest when you hold it to your ear.

glowing-rot.name: Glowing Rot
glowing-rot.description: A handful of greenish rotten wood that glows in the dark and never fades.

spore-pouch.name: Spore Pouch
spore-pouch.description: The dried skin of a puffball, full of choking dust.

earwig-pincers.name: Earwig Pincers
earwig-pincers.description: A pair of curved, glossy pincers that snap shut on their own.

rusty-spur.name: Rusty Spur
rusty-spur.description: An old rowel spur that jingles by itself when someone walks the road.

chochol-straw.name: Strawman's Sheaf
chochol-straw.description: A bundle of straw that rustles in rhythm, though no one is playing.

cold-candle.name: Cold Candle
cold-candle.description: The stub of a black candle that burns with frost instead of fire.

deadman-shroud.name: Dead Man's Shroud
deadman-shroud.description: A shred of grey linen, cold as the earth of a grave.

beetle-antenna.name: Beetle Antenna
beetle-antenna.description: An orange, club-tipped antenna that senses the dead through a fathom of earth.

bell-clapper.name: Bell Clapper
bell-clapper.description: The iron clapper of a cracked bell, cold as ice. At midnight it strikes by itself.

abomination-tooth.name: Abomination Tooth
abomination-tooth.description: A crooked tooth as big as a hand, crusted with dried black blood.

matted-tangle.name: Matted Tangle
matted-tangle.description: A dense tangle of black hair in which something still moves.

bebok-sack.name: Bogeyman's Sack
bebok-sack.description: An old, patched sack of coarse cloth. Something scratches inside.

plague-kerchief.name: Plague Kerchief
plague-kerchief.description: A long, blood-red kerchief. Wherever it flutters, the grass withers.

moon-bite.name: Moon Morsel
moon-bite.description: A pale, cold crumb bitten off the moon. It shines even on the darkest night.

scraps.name: Scraps
scraps.description: Bits of leather, bone and feather, cleaned and trimmed.

fittings.name: Fittings
fittings.description: Buckles, rivets and plates for joining parts.

shards.name: Crystal Splinters
shards.description: As sharp as glass and harder than steel.

amber.name: Amber
amber.description: A warm lump of resin from ages past.

bloodstone.name: Bloodstone
bloodstone.description: A dark red stone with veins like blood.

star-shard.name: Star Shard
star-shard.description: A splinter that fell from the sky and still glows faintly.
